description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Sales/ProcessOrderLine. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Starts automatic supplier purchase processing for exact existing order lines using the current saved auto-ordering settings. ownerAgent: orders-autoordering. Use when: Use it when the user explicitly wants to process or retry an existing order after correcting a payment card or another auto-ordering setting. Input: [FromBody] rq: LoadAddressesFromOrderLineRequest. Main fields: OrderLineIds: int[]. Required Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Attempts normal processing for each supplied order line and returns refreshed order data on success or the processing error result. Search terms: sales processorderline. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_sales_processorderline
title: Post Sales Processorderline
